);

                    delay_intern <= delay_intern + 4'b0001;
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

      end
      else begin
        sNEXT_STATE <= DRAW;
      end
    end
    B_LEAD : begin
      if((iA == 2'b00) && (iB == 2'b01)) begin
        sNEXT_STATE <= B_LEAD;
      end
      else if((iA == 2'b01) && (iB == 2'b00)) begin
        sNEXT_STATE <= A_LEAD;
      end
      else begin
        sNEXT_STATE <= B_WIN;
      end
    end
    B_WIN : begin
      if((iA == 2'b00) && (iB == 2'b01)) begin
        sNEXT_STATE <= B_LEAD;

        sNEXT_STATE <= A_LEAD;
      end
      else begin
        sNEXT_STATE <= B_WIN;
      end

      end

      end

      end
    end
    default : begin
      sNEXT_STATE <= DRAW;
    end
    endcase
